ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (near-black) with sparse high-intensity (white) pixels restricted to barnacle clusters and focal scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous regions across both lobes; high-contrast white focal spots detected at central-right coordinates and high-density textured clusters at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory follows a convex curve from the notch, transitioning into a concave sweep toward the upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on fluke tips and trailing edges; multiple circular white depigmented scars on the ventral surface; distinct diagonal rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy localized biofouling at the distal tips creating a ragged, high-intensity perimeter texture contrasting sharply with the smooth dark pigmentation of the main fluke body.
